# Portfolio Website Instructions

- Use Next.js App Router with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.
- Keep the portfolio visually premium, responsive, and motion-rich.
- Favor concise copy, strong QA/automation/AI positioning, and clear calls to action.
- Use Framer Motion for section reveals and GSAP for hero polish.
- Use Three.js only for lightweight decorative background effects.
- Keep the site easy to deploy on Vercel.
